series.title: Gas Prices
series.description: Average retail price of regular gasoline in San Francisco. Higher fuel costs squeeze household budgets within weeks.

series.title: Diesel Prices
series.description: Average retail price of on-highway diesel in California. Diesel drives food transport costs, ours included.

series.title: Egg Prices
series.description: Wholesale price of a dozen large shell eggs in California. Eggs are a staple protein and their price swings fast.
series.source: USDA AMS, California Shell Egg report (2844)

series.title: Chicken Prices
series.description: National composite wholesale price of whole broilers, per pound. California does not have its own chicken price report.
series.source: USDA AMS, Weekly National Chicken report (3646)

series.title: Beef Prices
series.description: National Choice boxed beef cutout value, dollars per hundred pounds. Tracks wholesale beef costs that reach stores within weeks.
series.source: USDA AMS, Daily Boxed Beef Cutout (2453)

series.title: Unemployment Claims
series.description: New (initial) unemployment insurance claims filed in California each week, as reported by EDD to the U.S. Department of Labor. Not seasonally adjusted.
series.source: CA EDD via U.S. DOL (FRED: CAICLAIMS)

series.title: WARN Layoff Notices
series.description: Workers covered by WARN layoff and closure notices filed by Bay Area employers, by week the notice was dated. Employers must file 60 days ahead, so this leads job losses.

series.title: Weekly Economic Index
series.description: The New York Fed's weekly read on national economic growth, scaled to annual GDP growth. A falling index signals a slowing economy.
series.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York (FRED: WEI)

series.title: Google Searches
series.description: Relative search interest in "food bank" in the San Francisco Bay Area (0 to 100 scale). Searches rise when more people look for help.

series.title: CalFresh Applications
series.description: CalFresh (SNAP) applications received in San Francisco and Marin counties each month. A direct read on how many households are seeking food help.
series.source: CA Dept. of Social Services, CF 296

series.title: Eviction Notices
series.description: Eviction notices filed with the San Francisco Rent Board each week. Housing instability often comes right before food insecurity.

series.title: Rents
series.description: Typical asking rent across all home types in the San Francisco metro (Zillow Observed Rent Index, smoothed). Rising rents leave less for food.
